ops.body: Criterion 620adff (shared cross-language fixture) is deferred, not met — split out as task 7b93780 and routed to Phase 3's Swift-lockstep row, where the fixture is built once against the post-collapse frame set rather than twice. The security defect this task filed is fixed: fe4a534 moved the authoritative uid off the optional SessionPolicy onto a non-optional serviceOwnerUserID uid_t, so sessionPolicy == nil is structurally incapable of suppressing the check. What remains is a divergence-regression guard, not the fix.
